prior_information: Earlier OOD/main/repeated and some exactly reused ID answers are known. This is a prospective analysis freeze for the extension, not study-wide untouched confirmation.

population.checkpoint_policy: Exact frozen127 roster only. No later Qwen B7/new GPT C weights. Qwen partial means F1-trained; this target has no GPT counterpart.
population.scope: Main source estimates equal-weight all three fixed domains. Domain/positive/negative estimates all printed descriptively; no selected-domain testing. Crossmodel shared finding requires both separately adjusted effects with same metric/source/contrast/direction.

reporting.descriptive_only: Precision, recall, Jaccard, exact accuracy, parseability, confidence mean/SD, AP and other companion endpoints; no new p-values for these. No within-question sampling dispersion claims from one new draw.
reporting.confidence_population: Canonical valid finite-confidence answers; all known invalid answers retain correctness0. Common-valid paired sensitivity mandatory for calibration, strictly the same paired row IDs.
reporting.evidence_population: Canonical literal AND semantic support; empty predicted set/known invalid has support0. Report positive/negative strata and predicted count. Unknown semantics remain null plus fraction0..1/count0..predicted_count bounds.

recipe_family.status: New explicit secondary extension family; old192/384/512 families unchanged.
recipe_family.correction: BH320 main, Holm320 sensitivity; unavailable slots retain p1.

baseline_family.status: Separate new secondary family, same metrics and scopes.
baseline_family.correction: BH320 main, Holm320 sensitivity; unavailable p1.
baseline_family.SFT: One own-model SFT checkpoint, identical questions/mode/draw. Shared once across trained seeds, never counted as independent baseline replicates.

estimator: For each checkpoint/domain compute canonical metric over exactly fixed row views. Average all three domain metrics equally, then paired seed contrasts equally. Never average only defined domains. SFT difference is trained-seed mean minus one baseline metric.

inference.unit: Underlying conversation, with all policy views and any cross-domain views tied to one bootstrap weight and one arm-label swap; no policy-view or seed/draw pseudo-replication. Source panel has75 SP conversation hashes across180 policy views and220 Dyna hashes across220 rows. Verify robust original/normalized conversation linkage before inference.
inference.bootstrap: 1999 paired conversation-cluster multinomial resamples per source, identical fixed seed741920 across arms/models; preserve each cluster all views, then recompute within-domain normalized metric and equal-domain aggregate. Percentile95 confidence intervals conditional on these fixed checkpoints/question support.
inference.test: 1999 whole-conversation arm-label permutations, fixed seed192011, shared swap across all paired training seeds/policy views. Two-sided plus-one p. Nonlinear metrics recomputed after each swap. Conditional joint arm-label exchangeability null, not merely equality of one metric and not seed-population randomization.
inference.SFT_null: One conversation-level swap jointly applied to the complete trained-seed response vector and the shared SFT response broadcast only for algebra; never independent per-seed baseline swaps. This tests a strong conditional joint-response exchangeability null, not training-seed replication.
inference.undefined: Strict complete source/domain/seed endpoint required. Constant correlations/class-undefined AUROC remain unavailable p1, not zero. Require at least95% defined resamples. Undefined null resamples count as extreme, so cannot lower p; no CI/method changes after results.
inference.missing: Provider unknowns never re-sampled/imputed0. Primary slot unavailable if required outcomes missing. One globally frozen union-of-unknown question exclusion across127 is a separately labeled complete-case sensitivity, not replacement. Semantic missingness receives explicit deterministic bounds; adverse missing-grade-aware upper p can be reported only as whole-family conservative sensitivity for all support slots using existing reviewed bounds method.
inference.seed_scope: Report exact per-seed vectors and count; fixed checkpoints conditional. Shared model-specific findings do not imply identical paired seed populations. Matched seed intersection sensitivity descriptive; binary crossmodel can have only seed2.

prohibited: No outcome-selected domains/rows/endpoints/weights/folds or later checkpoints.
No choosing a CI, null method or correction because it produces significance.
No new provider calls or runtime changes by this plan.
No small ID panel statistical result replaces original OOD tests.
